name: Grammar Ceiling Hypothesis — Static vs Dynamic Dictionary
description: Formalizes the Grammar Ceiling Hypothesis (GCH): the claim that for a bounded symbolic grammar, additional compute yields no structural progress beyond the grammar ceiling, and that operator-guided grammar expansion is the correct mechanism for breaking it. Debates the static-vs-dynamic dictionary argument, the alien math API counter-hypothesis, roadmap implications for tacrolimus biological primitives, and the paper5 framing of GCH as a standalone publishable scientific claim.
